sources.org: European Commission, DG Taxation and Customs Union, with Eurostat
sources.title: Data on Taxation Trends: National Tax Lists (NTL), edition 2026
sources.note: Workbook "NTL edition 2026 web.xlsx", sheet HR: every tax and social contribution by its national name and ESA code, in EUR million. Data cut-off 30 October 2025.

sources.title: Main national accounts tax aggregates (gov_10a_taxag)
sources.note: Taxes and social contributions by sub-sector and ESA item; used to place each tax at a level (all the personal income tax, EUR 3,389 million, is S.1313) and to check the totals of the National Tax List.

sources.title: Worldwide Tax Summaries: Croatia – Corporate – Taxes on corporate income
sources.note: A professional firm’s summary, not an official source: corporate income tax 18%, 10% for revenue below EUR 1 million.

sources.title: Worldwide Tax Summaries: Croatia – Individual – Taxes on personal income
sources.note: A professional firm’s summary: progressive personal income tax rates chosen by each local self-government unit between 15% and 33%; flat rates for other income.

sources.title: Worldwide Tax Summaries: Croatia – Corporate – Other taxes
sources.note: A professional firm’s summary: VAT 25% general, 13% reduced; employers’ health insurance contribution 16.5% of gross salary.
